Comments.UseMockServices: Set to false for Aspire-backed L3 testing so the app exercises real HTTP/API services instead of in-browser mocks.
Comments.UseApiGateway: Set to true for L3 testing so the Blazor app routes through the Aspire-hosted API Gateway.
Comments.BaseUrl: Fallback service URL for direct HTTP calls. In Testing, requests should normally go through the API Gateway instead.
Comments.ApiGatewayUrl: Stable API Gateway URL exposed by the Aspire AppHost during L3 test execution.
